scope: Minimal server compatibility with fallible tokenizer and causal inference; integrated snapshot gate
selection: Build a compatibility version from HEAD in target/delivery-review, then select its blob into the index. encode and forward errors propagate; nonstreaming errors return HTTP 500/inference_error after releasing admission, streaming errors return to the existing error path. decode_single remains infallible. Also sort runtime module exports as required by changed-file rustfmt.

preservation.note: The pending server batching/remote rewrite is untouched. This staged compatibility version is intentionally different from the worktree file.

environment: Fresh dedicated build directory. Debug symbols disabled after the default-debug build exhausted disk during the audit; test assertions and Cargo test profile behavior otherwise unchanged. Snapshot has a local Git context referencing the selected tree and actual base so the gate runs inside it, not in the original worktree.
limits: 630 tests and 28 mapped scenarios describe this selected delivery snapshot, not the larger uncommitted worktree. The canonical gate does not execute coverage/mutation campaigns or hardware measurements. Global mutation, ARM/PMU/cloud, work-stealing Loom and remaining spec delivery tasks are not closed by this result.
